'''2000 German National Championship''' was the German Star Wars CCG national championship of spring 2000. [[Markus Wüst]] finished 3rd with a Dark ISB deck and a Light deck he had posted earlier as "Break Stuff".<ref name="dt-6235">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/6235 Der Abschaum der Gesellschaft], DeckTech (Markus "Lone Gunner" Wuest, 2 May 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/6235/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/6235/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 2000 (before 26 April)
* '''Site:''' Germany
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]

== Decklists ==
Players posted these lists on DeckTech as decks they played at the event; the posted list may differ slightly from the one played.

* [[2000 German National Championship Markus Wüst Der Abschaum der Gesellschaft]] ([[Markus Wüst]], [[Dark]]; 3rd) — "finished 3rd on the German Nationals with that"
* [[2000 German National Championship Markus Wüst Break Stuff ver 1 1]] ([[Markus Wüst]], [[Light]]; 3rd) — "I finshed 3rd on the german national with this deck"
